name: Barton Hall
use: Thompson School of Applied Science: animal science and food labs, classrooms, offices (built with a dairy and ice-cream plant)
architect: Edward Benton Miles (builder: The Maxam Co.)

facts.text: Barton Hall is named for Philip Shaw Barton, first director of the Thompson School of Applied Science, who helped found it in 1953.
It was designed by Edward Benton Miles and built by The Maxam Co.; planning began in 1963 and construction finished in 1969, and it was dedicated April 10, 1970.
It originally held a modern dairy and ice-cream manufacturing plant, along with classrooms, demonstration space, labs and offices.
By 2008 it contained an animal science lab, a food preparation lab, a grooming facility, classrooms and faculty offices.

verdict: Plain 1969 Thompson School lab building, built around a dairy plant; serviceable and anonymous.
